hero.title: INVEST IN
hero.intro: Choose the level of support that matches your goals. We’ll confirm the right option together during your free intake.

plans.title: 3 months
plans.text: Weekly personal training for three months, ideal for building momentum, confidence and a consistent routine.

plans.title: 12 months
plans.text: Ongoing coaching at the best session rate, for people ready to make strength training a lasting habit.

plans.title: Two sessions
plans.text: A 3-month contract to kickstart your training, including two sessions, an individual schedule and consistent feedback.

plans.title: Single session
plans.text: A focused one-off session for a specific lift or goal, with no ongoing contract.

note: All prices are shown in euros. Final programme structure and session frequency are agreed during intake.

items.question: Which option should I choose?
items.answer: You do not need to decide alone. The free intake is used to understand your goals and discuss the most suitable option.

items.question: Are the prices final?
items.answer: Prices are shown in euros. Session frequency and the final programme structure are confirmed together during intake.

items.question: Can I book just one session?
items.answer: Yes. The single session is designed for one specific lift, movement or training question, without an ongoing contract.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy?
items.answer: Appointments should be cancelled or moved at least 24 hours in advance. Full details are available in the terms.
